def instrument_model_call(fn):
    @wraps(fn)
    async def wrapper(messages, provider, model, scenario):
        from tools import TOOL_DEFINITIONS
        selected_model = model if provider == "ollama" else "offline-rule-engine"
        schema = LlmSpan(name="chat", input=safe_messages(messages), model=selected_model,
                         output=Message(role=MessageRole.assistant, content=""), tools=TOOL_DEFINITIONS if provider == "ollama" else None)
        if provider == "ollama":
            schema.temperature = 0.2
        started = time.perf_counter()
        error_type = None
        with start_splunk_ao_span(schema) as span:
            if len(messages) > _MAX_MESSAGES or any(m.content.startswith('{"truncated":true') for m in schema.input):
                span.set_attribute("assistant.capture.truncated", True)
            span.set_attribute("gen_ai.provider.name", provider)
            span.set_attribute("gen_ai.request.stream", False)
            if provider == "ollama":
                span.set_attribute("gen_ai.request.max_tokens", 512)
                span.set_attribute("assistant.request.num_ctx", 8192)
            try:
                response = await fn(messages, provider, model, scenario)
                answer = response.get("message", {})
                schema.output = Message(role=MessageRole.assistant, content=safe_json(answer) if answer.get("tool_calls") else safe_text(answer.get("content", "")))
                response_model = response.get("model")
                if response_model:
                    span.set_attribute("gen_ai.response.model", response_model)
                schema.finish_reason = response.get("done_reason")
                inp, out = response.get("prompt_eval_count"), response.get("eval_count")
                schema.metrics = LlmMetrics(num_input_tokens=inp if isinstance(inp, int) else None,
                                             num_output_tokens=out if isinstance(out, int) else None)
                dims = {"gen_ai.operation.name": "chat", "gen_ai.provider.name": provider, "gen_ai.request.model": selected_model}
                if response_model:
                    dims["gen_ai.response.model"] = response_model
                for kind, count in (("input", inp), ("output", out)):
                    if isinstance(count, int):
                        _token_usage.record(count, {**dims, "gen_ai.token.type": kind})
                return response
            except BaseException as exc:
                _error(span, schema, exc)
                error_type = type(exc).__name__
                raise
            finally:
                dimensions = {"gen_ai.operation.name": "chat", "gen_ai.provider.name": provider,
                              "gen_ai.request.model": selected_model}
                if error_type:
                    dimensions["error.type"] = error_type
                _model_duration.record(time.perf_counter() - started, dimensions)
    return wrapper

def set_llm_attributes(attrs: MutableMapping[str, AttributeValue], span: LlmSpan) -> None:
    """Map LLM request, response, content, and metric fields."""
    _set_operation(attrs, StepType.llm)
    attrs["gen_ai.input.messages"] = _input_messages(span.input)
    attrs["gen_ai.output.messages"] = _output_messages(span.output, span.finish_reason)
    _set_if_present(attrs, "gen_ai.request.model", span.model)
    _set_if_present(attrs, "gen_ai.request.temperature", span.temperature)
